content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Coordinator Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
AIIMS Jodhpur Research Coordinator Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Coordinator (non-medical) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Coordinator (non-medical) post at AIIMS Jodhpur is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is M.Sc. Biotechnology or equivalent with a Science background and sound knowledge of Genetics, Clinical Research, Biostatistics, and the use of statistical software.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Research Coordinator (non-medical) position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Coordinator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Research Coordinator (non-medical) position at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Coordinator role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a Walk-in Interview. A Screening/Scrutiny Test may also be conducted if deemed necessary.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur, Rajasthan, 342005.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis for the Research Coordinator (non-medical) position at AIIMS Jodhpur.
